name: Solo System Chromo
description: Not everyone has the space or budget for a cabin sauna. But everyone needs the benefits of infrared. For a healthier, happier you, envelop your entire body with the potent benefits of Sunlighten’s patented SoloCarbon® far infrared heating technology, engineered to produce an exceptionally high quantity of far infrared. Infrared density matters — the more far infrared your body absorbs, the more effectively it can support circulation, promote a deep sweat, ease muscle tension, and encourage relaxation. Our advanced heater is proven to raise core body temperature rather than simply heating the surrounding air, creating a more comfortable yet highly effective session!
